subject: Request: Security hiring package and compensation bands for Q3 hires
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-10 09:02 PDT
Subject: Request: Security hiring package and compensation bands for Q3 hires

Hi team,

I'm sending the proposed hiring package for Security & GRC that I referenced in last week's leadership sync. This thread contains the proposal I want to move into execution if we have approvals:

Summary (Q3 hires requested)
- 1x Senior Security Engineer (backend-focused, infra/serving runtime protection)
  - Level: IC4 / Senior
  - Proposed comp band: $170k - $210k base + 10% target bonus
- 1x GRC Manager (SOC 2 / audit + vendor risk)
  - Level: Manager
  - Proposed comp band: $140k - $170k base + 8% target bonus
- 1x Security Analyst (3rd line operations / triage)
  - Level: IC2
  - Proposed comp band: $100k - $125k base + 6% target bonus

Justification:
- Immediate gaps in SOC 2 evidence collection and remediation triage have created a backlog that affects renewals (esp. EU customers).
- Serving runtime work (KV cache boundaries, model route isolation) requires a strong senior hire to avoid future regressions as we roll Dedicated to new regions.
- We have an identified candidate funnel for Sr Eng (recruiter has 2 fast-moving leads).

Budget impact:
- Annualized OPEX run-rate increase ~ $550k fully loaded (including benefits & hiring overhead).
- We can absorb within Q3 hiring plan if we reallocate one open backend position from infra and delay a noncritical Platform PM.

Attachments: security_comp_bands_v2.pdf (detailed band ranges + comps by geography), org_security_team_proposal.png (proposed team alignment), offer_template_Sr_Eng.docx (draft).

Ask: please reply with approvals or change requests by EOD Monday (2026-06-11). If approved, I'll instruct Talent to send offers and ask Recruiting (Tim) to prioritize the Sr Eng funnel.

Thanks,
- Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security & GRC
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10 11:18 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: Security hiring package and compensation bands for Q3 hires

Hannah — thanks for the concise package. Quick thoughts: 

- I support hiring the Sr Security Engineer at the top of the band for a strong candidate; this role will materially lower our time-to-fix on infra regressions.
- GRC Manager band looks OK, but can we carve out a small candidate sign-on allowance (one-time) for hard-to-get audit leads?
- Security Analyst: agree with the lower band; we should keep an internal headcount swing (float) to speed hiring if needed.

One ask from my side: can you add an explicit 6-month ramp OKR for the Sr Eng (owner of KV cache security + two measurable deliverables) into the offer/role doc? That will help me justify comp to Finance.

Approve in principle. Waiting on finance confirmation for the final numbers.

- Marissa
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10 13:04 PDT
Subject: Fwd: Request: Security hiring package and compensation bands for Q3 hires

Looping Laura and Finance.

Laura — short note: this is a priority for customer-facing reliability and compliance; losing timeline here risks renewal conversations for a handful of mid-market EU accounts. If Finance needs levers, we can:
- Offer hiring as fixed-term contractor for 6 months for the Analyst to buy time
- Reallocate one open infra headcount as Hannah suggested

Tim from Recruiting (copied in the next message) has referrals and can provide market comps.

Karthik
Chief Operating Officer
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11 09:37 PDT
Subject: Re: Request: Security hiring package and compensation bands for Q3 hires

Thanks — I need a short cost breakdown for Finance before final sign-off. Hannah, could you confirm: 

1) Total OTE per role (base + target bonus + estimated equity uplift) summarized per hire and annualized fully loaded?
2) Are any of these hires expected to be remote (EU) vs US? If remote EU, we'll need to update bands.
3) Please confirm if the Sr Eng should be exempted from the standard new-hire salary cap given market scarcity.

I'll prioritize review once I have those numbers; tentatively okay to proceed if the Sr Eng case is strong and we keep headcount neutral by reallocating the infra role.

- Laura
Head of Finance
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Green <tim.green@recruitco.com>
Date: 2026-06-11 15:23 PDT
Subject: Final: Approve hiring package pending minor edits (band and ramp)

Quick update after syncing with Finance and Recruiting — approved pending the following small items:

- Hannah to add the 6-month ramp OKR language for Sr Eng into the role doc (Marissa will review).
- Add a $10k one-time sign-on allowance line in the GRC Manager offer bucket (Finance cleared headroom).
- Hannah to provide the brief cost table Laura requested (one-pager) and confirm remote/work location for each candidate.

Tim (recruiter): please prioritize the Sr Eng pipeline and hold the two leading candidates for 48 hours while we get the offer template finalized. Hannah: if you can get the cost sheet and ramp OKR to Marissa by tomorrow morning, we can finalize offers and instruct Talent to extend.

Approving in principle — proceed with prep.

Thanks,
- Marissa
VP, Product
[Attachment: offer_template_Sr_Eng.docx]
